Content: Team velocity giảm 3 sprints liên tiếp. Scrum Master investigate root causes nào?
Explanation: Technical debt accumulated, team burnout, unclear requirements (too much rework), external dependencies blocking, scope creep, team composition changes. SM facilitate retro focused on root cause analysis.
Option 1: Tech debt, burnout, unclear requirements/rework, external blocks, scope creep, team changes — retro root cause analysis
Option 2: Team lười — cần stricter management oversight và deadline enforcement
Option 3: SM performance issue — thay Scrum Master mới sẽ improve velocity
Option 4: Tools không phù hợp — upgrade Jira/Confluence license lên Enterprise

Content: Hệ thống legacy complex cần migration. PO muốn estimate toàn bộ upfront. Approach nào phù hợp?
Explanation: Cone of Uncertainty: estimate accuracy tăng theo thời gian. Approach: rough estimate (T-shirt sizing), spike để reduce uncertainty, re-estimate mỗi sprint. Progressive elaboration thay big-upfront estimation.
Option 1: Không estimate — bắt đầu code ngay và estimate khi gần xong
Option 2: Estimate chính xác tất cả tasks với Planning Poker — spend 2 tuần estimation session
Option 3: Rough estimate + spikes reduce uncertainty + re-estimate mỗi sprint — progressive elaboration thay big-upfront
Option 4: Outsource estimation cho consulting firm — external expertise accurate hơn

Content: Cross-functional team nhưng skill silos: chỉ 1 person biết testing, 1 biết DevOps. Risk gì và mitigation?
Explanation: Bus factor = 1 (person nghỉ → blocked). Mitigation: pair programming, knowledge sharing sessions, cross-training rotations, comprehensive documentation, gradually expand skills across team.
Option 1: Accept risk — team nhỏ luôn có single points of failure
Option 2: Bus factor 1 → pair programming, knowledge sharing, cross-training, documentation, skill expansion
Option 3: Hire backup person cho mỗi skill — redundancy qua headcount
Option 4: Outsource testing và DevOps — specialized vendors handle

Content: Stakeholders micromanage team: attend Daily Standup, question estimates, assign tasks. SM handle thế nào?
Explanation: SM protect team: educate stakeholders về Scrum roles (self-organizing team), redirect to PO cho priority changes, invite stakeholders to Sprint Review (proper ceremony), set boundaries diplomatically.
Option 1: Ignore stakeholders — team tự quyết định mọi thứ không cần input
Option 2: Let stakeholders attend tất cả ceremonies — transparency là Agile value
Option 3: Protect team: educate stakeholders Scrum roles, redirect to PO, invite to Review, set boundaries
Option 4: Escalate lên HR — stakeholders vi phạm team boundaries

Content: Distributed team (remote): Scrum ceremonies nào bị ảnh hưởng nhất và adapt thế nào?
Explanation: Daily Standup và Retrospective bị ảnh hưởng nhất (need high interaction). Adapt: async standup (Slack bot), video-first retros, shared digital boards (Miro), overlap hours, cultural awareness.
Option 1: Chỉ Sprint Planning bị ảnh hưởng — estimation khó khi remote
Option 2: Daily và Retro cần nhiều interaction nhất — async standup, video retro, digital boards, overlap hours
Option 3: Cancel tất cả ceremonies — async communication thay thế hoàn toàn
Option 4: Không ceremony nào bị ảnh hưởng — remote tools giải quyết mọi vấn đề

Content: Team consistently over-commit (100 points planned, 70 delivered mỗi sprint). Root cause và fix?
Explanation: Optimism bias, không account cho meetings/bugs/interruptions, PO pressure, unclear stories. Fix: use ACTUAL velocity (average last 3 sprints), buffer 20% cho unplanned work, PO respect team capacity.
Option 1: Optimism bias/pressure/unclear stories → dùng actual velocity (avg 3 sprints), buffer 20% unplanned, respect capacity
Option 2: Team cần work harder — 70 points mean 30% underperformance
Option 3: Tăng sprint length — 4 tuần thay 2 tuần cho thêm time
Option 4: Reduce story point value — 100 points thành 70 points bằng adjust scale

Content: Product Owner không available, backlog unclear. Sprint bị block. SM escalate thế nào?
Explanation: SM: communicate impact (blocked team = wasted cost), negotiate PO availability (min hours/sprint), propose proxy PO, escalate to management nếu cần. Team: refine what they can, address tech debt.
Option 1: SM become PO temporarily — combine roles cho efficiency
Option 2: Communicate impact, negotiate PO availability, propose proxy PO, escalate to management; team do tech debt
Option 3: Team tự đoán requirements — không cần PO input developer biết user cần gì
Option 4: Pause sprint và chờ PO available — team idle cho đến khi PO return

Content: Agile metrics: Lead Time vs Cycle Time vs Throughput đo lường gì?
Explanation: Lead Time: request → delivery (customer perspective). Cycle Time: work started → completed (team perspective). Throughput: items completed per time unit. Lead Time = queue time + Cycle Time.
Option 1: Lead Time: request→delivery; Cycle Time: started→completed; Throughput: items/time — Lead Time = queue + Cycle
Option 2: Lead Time và Cycle Time là cùng metric — chỉ khác tên gọi theo framework
Option 3: Lead Time cho sprints; Cycle Time cho releases — phân chia theo timeframe
Option 4: Throughput = Lead Time × Cycle Time — mathematical relationship

Content: Feature Flags (Feature Toggles) hỗ trợ Agile release strategy thế nào?
Explanation: Deploy code to production nhưng feature HIDDEN behind toggle. Benefits: trunk-based development (no long-lived branches), gradual rollout (% users), quick rollback (toggle off), A/B testing.
Option 1: Feature Flags chỉ cho frontend — backend features không toggle được
Option 2: Feature Flags thay thế Git branching hoàn toàn — không cần branches khi có flags
Option 3: Feature Flags chỉ cho hot-fixing production bugs — không liên quan đến feature release
Option 4: Deploy with feature hidden behind toggle — trunk-based dev, gradual rollout, quick rollback, A/B testing

Content: Agile transformation: organization chuyển từ Waterfall sang Agile. Top 3 challenges?
Explanation: 1) Culture shift (from command-control to self-organizing, trust). 2) Middle management resistance (role change/fear of irrelevance). 3) Organizational structure (functional silos → cross-functional teams).
Option 1: Training 2 ngày đủ cho toàn organization — Agile đơn giản chỉ cần hiểu framework
Option 2: Chỉ cần install Jira và rename meetings — transformation chỉ về tools
Option 3: Hire Agile coaches sẽ giải quyết mọi challenges — outsource transformation
Option 4: Culture shift (trust/self-organize), management resistance (role change), org structure (silos → cross-functional)
